MATHEMATICS — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #11
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In the number 3547, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 40
   C. 400
   D. 4

2. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. Cannot tell
   B. 2/2
   C. 1/4
   D. They are equal

3. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 42
   B. 24
   C. 36
   D. 12

4. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 26
   C. 170
   D. 169

5. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27.7
   B. 27.6
   C. 27
   D. 33

6. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 0.025
   B. 0.205
   C. 2.5
   D. 0.25

7. Solve for x: x + 6 = 17. (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 6
   C. 17
   D. 11

8. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15.6
   B. 15.7
   C. 21
   D. 15

9. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 49
   C. 50
   D. 14

10. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 4 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 30
   C. 44
   D. 15

11. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 7 cm and 24 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 27
   B. 31
   C. 25
   D. 17

12. In the number 3147, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 10
   C. 4
   D. 400

13. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 121
   B. 11
   C. 122
   D. 22

14. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 43
   C. 1
   D. 2

15. What is 8 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 25
   C. 11
   D. 24

16. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 19.7
   C. 19.6
   D. 19

17. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x
   B. 6x + 2
   C. 6x
   D. 12x + 2

18. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 144
   B. 156
   C. 24
   D. 48

19. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 31
   C. 2
   D. 1

20. What is 8 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 13
   C. 41
   D. 3

21. What is √25? (1 mark)
   A. 6
   B. 12.5
   C. 25
   D. 5

22. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 2

23. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23.6
   B. 23.7
   C. 23
   D. 29

24. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 4 cm. (1 mark)

25. What is 4 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 12

26. What is 4 × 6? (1 mark)

27. What is 4 × 9? (1 mark)

30. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
